module_summary: UART receiver controller decodes serial input using programmable timer and phase counter; outputs received bytes via AXI Stream handshake with error flags.

anchors.name: rxd
anchors.why: Serial input line, sampled and synchronized for bit reception.

anchors.name: prescale
anchors.why: Configurable divisor for baud rate timing.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid pulse when byte reception completes.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready signal, gates acknowledgment of received data.

anchors.name: smp
anchors.why: Synchronization flip-flop for rxd edge detection and start-bit sensing.

anchors.name: phase_k
anchors.why: Bit counter during frame reception, counts from DATA_WIDTH+2 down to 0.

anchors.name: tick_ok
anchors.why: Timer tick output from child urx_tmr, gates phase advancement.

anchors.name: frag
anchors.why: Received byte from child urx_sipo shift register.

anchors.name: t_go
anchors.why: Combines tick_ok and active-sequence detection; advances phase counter each cycle.

anchors.name: kick
anchors.why: Resets timer and shift register for new frame reception when idle.

anchors.name: tail_good
anchors.why: Validates received byte and latches it into output register.

anchors.name: in_body
anchors.why: Decodes data-bit phase; controls shift-register advance and timer reload.

groups.name: Serial Input Interface
groups.description: Serial input line and baud-rate configuration.

groups.name: Synchronization and Timer
groups.description: Synchronizes serial input and manages bit-rate timing via programmable counter.

groups.name: Bit Counter and Shift Register
groups.description: Counts bit positions and collects shifted-in data from serial stream.

groups.name: Reception Phase Control
groups.description: Decodes receive phases and generates control signals for timer and shift register sequencing.

groups.name: Output Handshake
groups.description: AXI Stream output with received byte and valid/ready handshake.
